# Yes My Shawarma

> Yes My Shawarma is a shawarma, burger, and fast-food restaurant with multiple branches in Accra, Ghana, offering online ordering for pickup and delivery.

## Ordering

- [Menu](https://www.yesmyshawarma.com/menu): Full menu of shawarma, burgers, hot dogs, loaded fries, sandwiches, and drinks, with prices in Ghanaian cedis (GHS).
- [Branches](https://www.yesmyshawarma.com/branches): Branch locations, addresses, phone numbers, and opening hours across Accra.
- [Track an order](https://www.yesmyshawarma.com/track): Look up the status of an existing order.

## About

- [About us](https://www.yesmyshawarma.com/about): Background on the business and its story.
- [Contact us](https://www.yesmyshawarma.com/contact): Contact form and branch phone numbers.
- [FAQ](https://www.yesmyshawarma.com/faq): Answers to common ordering questions.
- [Customer reviews](https://www.yesmyshawarma.com/reviews): Public customer reviews and ratings.

## Policies

- [Terms & Conditions](https://www.yesmyshawarma.com/terms-and-conditions)
- [Refund Policy](https://www.yesmyshawarma.com/refund-policy)
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.yesmyshawarma.com/privacy-policy)
- [Cookie Policy](https://www.yesmyshawarma.com/cookie-policy)

## Notes

- Payment: cash on pickup/delivery, or online via card/Mobile Money through Paystack.
- Delivery is available in select areas of Accra; pickup is available at every branch during its opening hours.
